prompt_en: Create a photorealistic cinematic editorial photograph in a rain-flooded abandoned observatory at midnight. An unmistakably adult woman serves as the living operator. Her visible facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and natural styling follow the reference portrait. Treat the uploaded portrait as the sole identity source and keep unchanged her eye aperture, eye shape and spacing, eyebrows, nose, lips, face length, lower-face and jaw width, cheekbones, skin tone, natural asymmetry, hairline, and adult age; preserve the same facial structure instead of structurally beautifying, dollifying, de-aging, substituting, or averaging it. A living necromancer deliberately questions a specific dead astronomer. A living operator deliberately questions the dead by pressing two fingers to the astronomer's portrait medallion. One named dead person is linked through portrait or remains: the astronomer Elian Voss appears in the recognizable medallion, and the apparition repeats that same face and antique collar. A memorial instrument visibly links the living operator and the dead: the medallion rests inside an original abstract ring of smooth dark stones. The linked apparition changes locally in response, forming directly above the touched medallion and pointing at one moving star. The apparition points toward one moving star while the wet brass chart needle has visibly shifted in response. The answer changes one physical instrument: the needle is caught displaced from its engraved zero mark, with rainwater rippling around the new position. Use a wide three-quarter view tight enough to place her hand, medallion, apparition, and shifted needle in one central causal zigzag. A slightly raised 35 mm camera makes the cracked brass meridians converge through those four elements. Practical moonlight through the dome and one warm instrument lamp share believable reflections across her wet sleeve, the stones, the apparition, the chart, and the flooded floor.
negative_en: fake-looking background, plastic-looking skin, broken facial features, body distortion, over-processed retouching, excessive HDR, unrealistic hands
